formative_worksheets.title: The Sort and Build Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming sort + congruent before movement.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can sort solids and find congruent pairs.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort solids and find congruent pairs.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Name 3 solids and count their faces.
prompts.visual_layout: Three solid icons with name and face count lines.

image_placeholders.description: Three solid icons (cube, pyramid, cylinder) for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art. Each with name and face count lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_SOLIDS at Prompt 1: keywords name the solid icons and faces count.

prompts.prompt: Are these 2 shapes CONGRUENT? YES or NO.
prompts.visual_layout: Two shapes side by side with a yes-or-no decision line.

image_placeholders.description: Two shape pairs for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art. First pair: 2 same-size squares. Second pair: 1 small + 1 big triangle. Below: YES / NO circles each.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_CONGRUENT at Prompt 2: keywords name the shape pairs congruent decision.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 3 formative check, B&W line art.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.

reflection_sheet.title: My Map It Move It Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig and Compass Coco with a Junior Geometer certificate in the top-right. References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: How do you feel? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals for Grade 3 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_STARS at Prompt 1: keywords name the star rating visual.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table for Grade 3 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_YN_TABLE at Prompt 2: keywords name response options.

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Grade 3 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_FAV_BOX at Prompt 3: keywords name the favourite activity focus.

prompts.prompt: The trickiest part for me was...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Grade 3 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_TRICKY_BOX at Prompt 4: keyword names the trickiest part focus.

prompts.prompt: Next time, I want to try...

image_placeholders.description: A bordered rectangle for Grade 3 reflection.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: REF_NEXT_BOX at Prompt 5: keywords name the next-time focus.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the end of Lesson 5 alongside Junior Geometer certificate.
